clips.text: 这不是我们第一次见面了，但请容我重新介绍自己，无名者，很幸运能成为你箱子里的一员。

subtitle.zh: 这不是我们第一次见面了，但请容我重新介绍自己，无名者，很幸运能成为你箱子里的一员。
subtitle.en: We're well past introductions, Timekeeper, but I'm grateful to do so again with a name of my own. I'm Miss Stranger, though I'm glad you've welcomed me here not as a stranger, but as a friend.

clips.text: 曾有一个人颤抖着找到我，对我说：救救我，Grace女士，我知道暴雨要来了。

subtitle.zh: 曾有一个人颤抖着找到我，对我说：救救我，Grace女士，我知道暴雨要来了。
subtitle.en: A man once came to me trembling. Please help me, Miss Grace, he begged. I know about the storm. Is this it? Is it coming?

clips.text: 他很快就戴上了面具，可那天落下的只是一场再普通不过的雨，而我多希望自己当时能做出别的选择。

subtitle.zh: 他很快就戴上了面具，可那天落下的只是一场再普通不过的雨，而我多希望自己当时能做出别的选择。
subtitle.en: He had no idea it was nothing more than a rainy day. It was simple to convince him to put on the mask, but I wish I had done something, anything else.

clips.text: 我扮演过身份各异的人，但不知道自己生于何处。

subtitle.zh: 我扮演过身份各异的人，但不知道自己生于何处。
subtitle.en: I've worn so many names, living their lives, yet I know so little of my own.

clips.text: 故乡对我来说是一个随时可以被重新设定的词语，我曾在一份与我有关的文件中看见了冰岛这个词，但我没有任何一个身份来自冰岛。

subtitle.zh: 故乡对我来说是一个随时可以被重新设定的词语，我曾在一份与我有关的文件中看见了冰岛这个词，但我没有任何一个身份来自冰岛。
subtitle.en: My home has always just been a line in a mission file. Once I saw Iceland in one of those papers. I've never had an identity from there.

clips.text: 也许有一天，我们能一起去那座岛上看看。我仍在习惯这种崭新的平静生活。

subtitle.zh: 也许有一天，我们能一起去那座岛上看看。我仍在习惯这种崭新的平静生活。
subtitle.en: Perhaps it would be worth visiting some day. I'm still getting used to this new, peaceful life.

clips.text: 目前看来，我们相处愉快，很少有机会能让我像这样，不用去思考任何事。

subtitle.zh: 目前看来，我们相处愉快，很少有机会能让我像这样，不用去思考任何事。
subtitle.en: Knowing I don't need to look over my shoulder anymore feels strange, but comforting.

clips.text: 你来了，需要什么帮助吗？

subtitle.zh: 你来了，需要什么帮助吗？
subtitle.en: Hello there. What brings you here? Anything I can help with?

clips.text: 我可以为你处理一些文书书写工作，或者文书伪造工作。

subtitle.zh: 我可以为你处理一些文书书写工作，或者文书伪造工作。
subtitle.en: I could handle some paperwork, or perhaps forge some documents, if that's needed.

clips.text: 班尼班尼小姐经常为我准备不一样的早餐，也许是因为我说过我也不知道自己喜欢吃什么。

subtitle.zh: 班尼班尼小姐经常为我准备不一样的早餐，也许是因为我说过我也不知道自己喜欢吃什么。
subtitle.en: Miss Bunny Bunny always makes sure there's something new for me to try at breakfast. Her solution to my lack of hometown recipes.

clips.text: 那些餐点都很美味，而她看起来也很高兴能有一位味觉立场中立的品评测试员。

subtitle.zh: 那些餐点都很美味，而她看起来也很高兴能有一位味觉立场中立的品评测试员。
subtitle.en: It's always been enough to satisfy my curiosity. And I can sense that she takes a great deal of joy from getting my unbiased assessments.

clips.text: 我过去常常连续数日无法入睡。若不是趋光性定律不断复写我的大脑以维持机能，我想我早就疯了。

subtitle.zh: 我过去常常连续数日无法入睡。若不是趋光性定律不断复写我的大脑以维持机能，我想我早就疯了。
subtitle.en: I was often required to work without sleep for days at a time. If not for the phototaxis rewriting my brain to keep me functional, I think I would have lost my mind.

clips.text: 你要不要试着睡得更早，起得更早一些呢？

subtitle.zh: 你要不要试着睡得更早，起得更早一些呢？
subtitle.en: But since you don't have that, you really ought to consider a better sleep schedule.

clips.text: 这里的夜晚很安静，没有通宵达旦的晚宴和喋喋不休的阴谋。

subtitle.zh: 这里的夜晚很安静，没有通宵达旦的晚宴和喋喋不休的阴谋。
subtitle.en: The evenings here are delightfully peaceful. No more clinking glasses and scheming and a hushed breath.

clips.text: 我也不需要借着月色，赶在日出之前，将所有有价值的情报记录在几只小小的飞蛾里。

subtitle.zh: 我也不需要借着月色，赶在日出之前，将所有有价值的情报记录在几只小小的飞蛾里。
subtitle.en: No need to listen in for intelligence to send off with my moths before the first light. Now I finally have this time to myself.

clips.text: 原来荒原里也有不少飞虫，他们经常被我房间里的灯光吸引，落在墙角上，也有不少是我从前没有见过的种类。

subtitle.zh: 原来荒原里也有不少飞虫，他们经常被我房间里的灯光吸引，落在墙角上，也有不少是我从前没有见过的种类。
subtitle.en: I've noticed a variety of flying insects in the wilderness. Some appear to be entirely new species. They're drawn in by my lights and come to rest in my room.

clips.text: 没关系，他们都是些有趣的客人，请交给我来处理就好。

subtitle.zh: 没关系，他们都是些有趣的客人，请交给我来处理就好。
subtitle.en: Oh, no need to be concerned. I welcome visitors of all shapes and sizes.

clips.text: 曾有一万七千六百零八条咒语留在我的脑海里。它们如今沉寂了，但伤痕还留在我的颅骨之下，也许有一天会重新生效。

subtitle.zh: 曾有一万七千六百零八条咒语留在我的脑海里。它们如今沉寂了，但伤痕还留在我的颅骨之下，也许有一天会重新生效。
subtitle.en: There were 17,608 incantations in my mind at one point. Though they're silent now, the scars will remain. They may be activated again one day.

clips.text: 但现在，我更愿意把注意力放在来之不易的自由上。

subtitle.zh: 但现在，我更愿意把注意力放在来之不易的自由上。
subtitle.en: But for now, I'd prefer to cherish the freedom we fought so hard to win.

clips.text: 这把折扇常被人误认为是一支魔杖，而我也从未纠正过他们。

subtitle.zh: 这把折扇常被人误认为是一支魔杖，而我也从未纠正过他们。
subtitle.en: People often mistake my fan for a wand, and I've never corrected them.

clips.text: 其实我的神秘术并不需要这把扇子，它只是为了替我添几分淑女的仪态。

subtitle.zh: 其实我的神秘术并不需要这把扇子，它只是为了替我添几分淑女的仪态。
subtitle.en: It's only meant to lend me a bit of ladylike demeanor. Still, the less they know about me the better. Wouldn't you agree?

clips.text: 不过，能把它当成一枚烟幕弹，又何乐而不为呢？

subtitle.zh: 不过，能把它当成一枚烟幕弹，又何乐而不为呢？

clips.text: 这些针不只是装饰品，必要的时候也可以作为武器。

subtitle.zh: 这些针不只是装饰品，必要的时候也可以作为武器。
subtitle.en: These needles aren't mere accessories. They can serve as weapons if needed. It's a clever design.

clips.text: 我也推荐你随身携带一些像这样看似无害又能用来应急的工具。

subtitle.zh: 我也推荐你随身携带一些像这样看似无害又能用来应急的工具。
subtitle.en: I'd suggest getting something similar yourself.

clips.text: 我会观察箱子里的住客们平时会做些什么。

subtitle.zh: 我会观察箱子里的住客们平时会做些什么。
subtitle.en: I find that watching what people do here is a kind of entertainment in itself.

clips.text: 有的人会随着迪斯科音乐起舞，有的则会花一整个下午玩桌上游戏，还有一伙人经常凑在一起看恐怖电影。

subtitle.zh: 有的人会随着迪斯科音乐起舞，有的则会花一整个下午玩桌上游戏，还有一伙人经常凑在一起看恐怖电影。
subtitle.en: Some dance to disco music, some spend their afternoons playing table-pump games, and others watch horror films, until they're left huddled up together with fear.

clips.text: 我想，这也许只是旧习难改吧。但我仍在学着如何支配属于自己的时间。

subtitle.zh: 我想，这也许只是旧习难改吧。但我仍在学着如何支配属于自己的时间。
subtitle.en: I suppose it could. Just be that old habits die hard, but I'm still trying to learn what to do with my own time.

clips.text: 我仍在想，我们究竟怎样才能彻底击败阿卡纳？

subtitle.zh: 我仍在想，我们究竟怎样才能彻底击败阿卡纳？
subtitle.en: How can we possibly defeat Arcana?

clips.text: 或许你能找到一条可行的路。

subtitle.zh: 或许你能找到一条可行的路。
subtitle.en: I find myself asking that question over and over, but strange as it is, despite my worries, I trust you will find the answer.

clips.text: 我无法证明这一点，这只是一种凭借直觉而生的判断。

subtitle.zh: 我无法证明这一点，这只是一种凭借直觉而生的判断。
subtitle.en: But it's only a feeling.

clips.text: 所以，你不必在意我说的这些话。

subtitle.zh: 所以，你不必在意我说的这些话。
subtitle.en: I don't want to put the weight of all this on your shoulders alone.

clips.text: 留在我脑海里的，都是我作为工具而获得的记忆。

subtitle.zh: 留在我脑海里的，都是我作为工具而获得的记忆。
subtitle.en: My memories come from a time when I wasn't really a person, just a tool.

clips.text: 虽然它们时常令我痛苦，但我不应该抛弃铭记它们的责任。

subtitle.zh: 虽然它们时常令我痛苦，但我不应该抛弃铭记它们的责任。
subtitle.en: They feel like wounds, but they're mine to carry.

clips.text: 何况，其中也有一些，我希望能长留心中的往事。

subtitle.zh: 何况，其中也有一些，我希望能长留心中的往事。
subtitle.en: Besides, there are one or two things worth remembering.

clips.text: 箱子中，偶尔有人会向我打听一些基金会的密文。

subtitle.zh: 箱子中，偶尔有人会向我打听一些基金会的密文。
subtitle.en: I've noticed that others here can be rather inquisitive about the inside stories of the foundation.

clips.text: 当然，为了你我的安全着想，我会守口如瓶。

subtitle.zh: 当然，为了你我的安全着想，我会守口如瓶。
subtitle.en: Of course, I've never indulged their curiosity. It's safer for everyone that way.

clips.text: 不过，如果你需要一些特殊情报支援的话，我仍然可以为你提供一些帮助。

subtitle.zh: 不过，如果你需要一些特殊情报支援的话，我仍然可以为你提供一些帮助。
subtitle.en: That said, if you have any pressing questions, Timekeeper, I'd consider making an exception.

clips.text: 为了弥补神秘学家天生的缺陷，趋光性定律会在监测到强烈情绪波动时重置我的头脑。

subtitle.zh: 为了弥补神秘学家天生的缺陷，趋光性定律会在监测到强烈情绪波动时重置我的头脑。
subtitle.en: Phototaxis is designed to overcome an arcanist's innate flaws. By resetting our minds whenever intense emotional disturbances detect it, I had always assumed that once the phototaxis was lifted, there would be some kind of recoil, that I would cry all my suppressed tears.

clips.text: 我以为我会在摆脱控制的时候大哭一场，但这种事没有发生，至今都没有发生。

subtitle.zh: 我以为我会在摆脱控制的时候大哭一场，但这种事没有发生，至今都没有发生。
subtitle.en: Yet even now, there's nothing.

clips.text: 过去，每当人格被覆写，我的意识就会被关进一个小房间。那里四处散落着属于不同名字的遗物：Kayla与牛群的合照、Grace那些奇异的标本收藏、Newman伪造的车船票。我就用这些支离破碎的物件，从外面拼凑出自我的模样。

subtitle.zh: 过去，每当人格被覆写，我的意识就会被关进一个小房间。那里四处散落着属于不同名字的遗物：Kayla与牛群的合照、Grace那些奇异的标本收藏、Newman伪造的车船票。我就用这些支离破碎的物件，从外面拼凑出自我的模样。
subtitle.en: Whenever my identity was erased and rewritten, I felt as though my mind was forced into a small locked room, filled with keepsakes, a photograph of Kayla, with her cattle, specimens from Grace's collection, a forged ticket from Newman.

clips.text: 现在，那些碎片仍在原地，只是我不必再回去扮演一个虚假的自己。

subtitle.zh: 现在，那些碎片仍在原地，只是我不必再回去扮演一个虚假的自己。
subtitle.en: It was like studying my own past from the outside, that room is still there. But now, its door is always open.

clips.text: 但愿没人害怕飞虫。

subtitle.zh: 但愿没人害怕飞虫。
subtitle.en: No one is afraid of flying insects here, I hope.

clips.text: 我同意，这也是获取情报的有效方式。

subtitle.zh: 我同意，这也是获取情报的有效方式。
subtitle.en: An effective way of gathering intelligence, indeed.

clips.text: 静候时机，小心不起眼的飞虫，闭上眼吧，痛苦不会持续太久。

subtitle.zh: 静候时机，小心不起眼的飞虫，闭上眼吧，痛苦不会持续太久。
subtitle.en: Wait for the right moment. Even the most unremarkable insect may have a deadly sting. Close your eyes. The pain will pass quickly.

clips.text: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: That blinding light. Come loose like a breaking cocoon. Death is on its wings. Like a moth to the flame, at the quiver of scaled wings, lift the veil of lies. Please don't worry. I can tidy up, or make this look like nothing more than a tragic accident. Just tell me what you need.

clips.text: 终于，那只长久被遗弃在黑暗角落里的飞蛾，也感受到了阳光的温暖。

subtitle.zh: 终于，那只长久被遗弃在黑暗角落里的飞蛾，也感受到了阳光的温暖。
subtitle.en: At last, the moth, long abandoned in a dark corner, comes to feel the sun's warmth.

clips.text: 那些名字真正的主人已经逝去，而窃取了它们的小偷却获得了第二次生命。

subtitle.zh: 那些名字真正的主人已经逝去，而窃取了它们的小偷却获得了第二次生命。
subtitle.en: The rightful owners of those names are gone. Yet their thief was granted a second life.

clips.text: 但愿我能带着那些破碎的名字，找回属于我自己的生命。

subtitle.zh: 但愿我能带着那些破碎的名字，找回属于我自己的生命。
subtitle.en: I hope, in time, I can find some way to honor them.

subtitle.en: I could handle some paperwork, or perhaps forge some documents, if that's needed.

clips.text: Miss Bunny Bunny always makes sure there's something new for me to try at breakfast.

subtitle.zh: 班尼班尼小姐经常为我准备不一样的早餐，也许是因为我说过我也不知道自己喜欢吃什么。
subtitle.en: Miss Bunny Bunny always makes sure there's something new for me to try at breakfast.

clips.text: Her solution to my lack of hometown recipes.

subtitle.zh: 班尼班尼小姐经常为我准备不一样的早餐，也许是因为我说过我也不知道自己喜欢吃什么。
subtitle.en: Her solution to my lack of hometown recipes.

clips.text: It's always been enough to satisfy my curiosity.

subtitle.zh: 那些餐点都很美味，而她看起来也很高兴能有一位味觉立场中立的品评测试员。
subtitle.en: It's always been enough to satisfy my curiosity.

clips.text: And I can sense that she takes a great deal of joy from getting my unbiased assessments.

subtitle.zh: 那些餐点都很美味，而她看起来也很高兴能有一位味觉立场中立的品评测试员。
subtitle.en: And I can sense that she takes a great deal of joy from getting my unbiased assessments.

clips.text: I was often required to work without sleep for days at a time.

subtitle.zh: 我过去常常连续数日无法入睡。若不是趋光性定律不断复写我的大脑以维持机能，我想我早就疯了。
subtitle.en: I was often required to work without sleep for days at a time.

clips.text: If not for the phototaxis rewriting my brain to keep me functional, I think I would have lost my mind.

subtitle.zh: 我过去常常连续数日无法入睡。若不是趋光性定律不断复写我的大脑以维持机能，我想我早就疯了。
subtitle.en: If not for the phototaxis rewriting my brain to keep me functional, I think I would have lost my mind.

clips.text: But since you don't have that, you really ought to consider a better sleep schedule.

subtitle.zh: 你要不要试着睡得更早，起得更早一些呢？
subtitle.en: But since you don't have that, you really ought to consider a better sleep schedule.

clips.text: The evenings here are delightfully peaceful.

subtitle.zh: 这里的夜晚很安静，没有通宵达旦的晚宴和喋喋不休的阴谋。
subtitle.en: The evenings here are delightfully peaceful.

clips.text: No more clinking glasses and scheming and a hushed breath.

subtitle.zh: 这里的夜晚很安静，没有通宵达旦的晚宴和喋喋不休的阴谋。
subtitle.en: No more clinking glasses and scheming and a hushed breath.

clips.text: No need to listen in for intelligence to send off with my moths before the first light.

subtitle.zh: 我也不需要借着月色，赶在日出之前，将所有有价值的情报记录在几只小小的飞蛾里。
subtitle.en: No need to listen in for intelligence to send off with my moths before the first light.

clips.text: Now I finally have this time to myself.

subtitle.zh: 我也不需要借着月色，赶在日出之前，将所有有价值的情报记录在几只小小的飞蛾里。
subtitle.en: Now I finally have this time to myself.

clips.text: I've noticed a variety of flying insects in the wilderness.

subtitle.zh: 原来荒原里也有不少飞虫，他们经常被我房间里的灯光吸引，落在墙角上，也有不少是我从前没有见过的种类。
subtitle.en: I've noticed a variety of flying insects in the wilderness.

clips.text: Some appear to be entirely new species.

subtitle.zh: 原来荒原里也有不少飞虫，他们经常被我房间里的灯光吸引，落在墙角上，也有不少是我从前没有见过的种类。
subtitle.en: Some appear to be entirely new species.

clips.text: They're drawn in by my lights and come to rest in my room.

subtitle.zh: 原来荒原里也有不少飞虫，他们经常被我房间里的灯光吸引，落在墙角上，也有不少是我从前没有见过的种类。
subtitle.en: They're drawn in by my lights and come to rest in my room.

clips.text: Oh, no need to be concerned.

subtitle.zh: 没关系，他们都是些有趣的客人，请交给我来处理就好。
subtitle.en: Oh, no need to be concerned.

clips.text: I welcome visitors of all shapes and sizes.

subtitle.zh: 没关系，他们都是些有趣的客人，请交给我来处理就好。
subtitle.en: I welcome visitors of all shapes and sizes.

clips.text: There were 17,608 incantations in my mind at one point.

subtitle.zh: 曾有一万七千六百零八条咒语留在我的脑海里。它们如今沉寂了，但伤痕还留在我的颅骨之下，也许有一天会重新生效。
subtitle.en: There were 17,608 incantations in my mind at one point.

clips.text: Though they're silent now, the scars will remain.

subtitle.zh: 曾有一万七千六百零八条咒语留在我的脑海里。它们如今沉寂了，但伤痕还留在我的颅骨之下，也许有一天会重新生效。
subtitle.en: Though they're silent now, the scars will remain.

clips.text: They may be activated again one day.

subtitle.zh: 曾有一万七千六百零八条咒语留在我的脑海里。它们如今沉寂了，但伤痕还留在我的颅骨之下，也许有一天会重新生效。
subtitle.en: They may be activated again one day.

clips.text: But for now, I'd prefer to cherish the freedom we fought so hard to win.

subtitle.zh: 但现在，我更愿意把注意力放在来之不易的自由上。
subtitle.en: But for now, I'd prefer to cherish the freedom we fought so hard to win.

clips.text: People often mistake my fan for a wand, and I've never corrected them.

subtitle.zh: 这把折扇常被人误认为是一支魔杖，而我也从未纠正过他们。
subtitle.en: People often mistake my fan for a wand, and I've never corrected them.

clips.text: It's only meant to lend me a bit of ladylike demeanor.

subtitle.zh: 其实我的神秘术并不需要这把扇子，它只是为了替我添几分淑女的仪态。
subtitle.en: It's only meant to lend me a bit of ladylike demeanor.

clips.text: Still, the less they know about me the better.

subtitle.zh: 其实我的神秘术并不需要这把扇子，它只是为了替我添几分淑女的仪态。
subtitle.en: Still, the less they know about me the better.

clips.text: Wouldn't you agree?

subtitle.zh: 其实我的神秘术并不需要这把扇子，它只是为了替我添几分淑女的仪态。
subtitle.en: Wouldn't you agree?

clips.text: These needles aren't mere accessories.

subtitle.zh: 这些针不只是装饰品，必要的时候也可以作为武器。
subtitle.en: These needles aren't mere accessories.

clips.text: They can serve as weapons if needed.

subtitle.zh: 这些针不只是装饰品，必要的时候也可以作为武器。
subtitle.en: They can serve as weapons if needed.

clips.text: It's a clever design.

subtitle.zh: 这些针不只是装饰品，必要的时候也可以作为武器。
subtitle.en: It's a clever design.

clips.text: I'd suggest getting something similar yourself.

subtitle.zh: 我也推荐你随身携带一些像这样看似无害又能用来应急的工具。
subtitle.en: I'd suggest getting something similar yourself.

clips.text: I find that watching what people do here is a kind of entertainment in itself.

subtitle.zh: 我会观察箱子里的住客们平时会做些什么。
subtitle.en: I find that watching what people do here is a kind of entertainment in itself.

clips.text: Some dance to disco music, some spend their afternoons playing table-pump games, and others watch horror films, until they're left huddled up together with fear.

subtitle.zh: 有的人会随着迪斯科音乐起舞，有的则会花一整个下午玩桌上游戏，还有一伙人经常凑在一起看恐怖电影。
subtitle.en: Some dance to disco music, some spend their afternoons playing table-pump games, and others watch horror films, until they're left huddled up together with fear.

clips.text: I suppose it could. Just be that old habits die hard, but I'm still trying to learn what to do with my own time.

subtitle.zh: 我想，这也许只是旧习难改吧。但我仍在学着如何支配属于自己的时间。
subtitle.en: I suppose it could. Just be that old habits die hard, but I'm still trying to learn what to do with my own time.

clips.text: How can we possibly defeat Arcana?

subtitle.zh: 我仍在想，我们究竟怎样才能彻底击败阿卡纳？
subtitle.en: How can we possibly defeat Arcana?

clips.text: I find myself asking that question over and over, but strange as it is, despite my worries, I trust you will find the answer.

subtitle.zh: 或许你能找到一条可行的路。
subtitle.en: I find myself asking that question over and over, but strange as it is, despite my worries, I trust you will find the answer.

clips.text: But it's only a feeling.

subtitle.zh: 我无法证明这一点，这只是一种凭借直觉而生的判断。
subtitle.en: But it's only a feeling.

clips.text: I don't want to put the weight of all this on your shoulders alone.

subtitle.zh: 所以，你不必在意我说的这些话。
subtitle.en: I don't want to put the weight of all this on your shoulders alone.

clips.text: My memories come from a time when I wasn't really a person, just a tool.

subtitle.zh: 留在我脑海里的，都是我作为工具而获得的记忆。
subtitle.en: My memories come from a time when I wasn't really a person, just a tool.

clips.text: They feel like wounds, but they're mine to carry.

subtitle.zh: 虽然它们时常令我痛苦，但我不应该抛弃铭记它们的责任。
subtitle.en: They feel like wounds, but they're mine to carry.

clips.text: Besides, there are one or two things worth remembering.

subtitle.zh: 何况，其中也有一些，我希望能长留心中的往事。
subtitle.en: Besides, there are one or two things worth remembering.

clips.text: I've noticed that others here can be rather inquisitive about the inside stories of the foundation.

subtitle.zh: 箱子中，偶尔有人会向我打听一些基金会的密文。
subtitle.en: I've noticed that others here can be rather inquisitive about the inside stories of the foundation.

clips.text: Of course, I've never indulged their curiosity.

subtitle.zh: 当然，为了你我的安全着想，我会守口如瓶。
subtitle.en: Of course, I've never indulged their curiosity.

clips.text: It's safer for everyone that way.

subtitle.zh: 当然，为了你我的安全着想，我会守口如瓶。
subtitle.en: It's safer for everyone that way.

clips.text: That said, if you have any pressing questions, Timekeeper, I'd consider making an exception.

subtitle.zh: 不过，如果你需要一些特殊情报支援的话，我仍然可以为你提供一些帮助。
subtitle.en: That said, if you have any pressing questions, Timekeeper, I'd consider making an exception.

clips.text: Phototaxis is designed to overcome an arcanist's innate flaws.

subtitle.zh: 为了弥补神秘学家天生的缺陷，趋光性定律会在监测到强烈情绪波动时重置我的头脑。
subtitle.en: Phototaxis is designed to overcome an arcanist's innate flaws.

clips.text: By resetting our minds whenever intense emotional disturbances detect it, I had always assumed that once the phototaxis was lifted, there would be some kind of recoil, that I would cry all my suppressed tears.

subtitle.zh: 为了弥补神秘学家天生的缺陷，趋光性定律会在监测到强烈情绪波动时重置我的头脑。
subtitle.en: By resetting our minds whenever intense emotional disturbances detect it, I had always assumed that once the phototaxis was lifted, there would be some kind of recoil, that I would cry all my suppressed tears.

clips.text: Yet even now, there's nothing.

subtitle.zh: 我以为我会在摆脱控制的时候大哭一场，但这种事没有发生，至今都没有发生。
subtitle.en: Yet even now, there's nothing.

clips.text: Whenever my identity was erased and rewritten, I felt as though my mind was forced into a small locked room, filled with keepsakes, a photograph of Kayla, with her cattle, specimens from Grace's collection, a forged ticket from Newman.

subtitle.zh: 过去，每当人格被覆写，我的意识就会被关进一个小房间。那里四处散落着属于不同名字的遗物：Kayla与牛群的合照、Grace那些奇异的标本收藏、Newman伪造的车船票。我就用这些支离破碎的物件，从外面拼凑出自我的模样。
subtitle.en: Whenever my identity was erased and rewritten, I felt as though my mind was forced into a small locked room, filled with keepsakes, a photograph of Kayla, with her cattle, specimens from Grace's collection, a forged ticket from Newman.

clips.text: It was like studying my own past from the outside, that room is still there.

subtitle.zh: 现在，那些碎片仍在原地，只是我不必再回去扮演一个虚假的自己。
subtitle.en: It was like studying my own past from the outside, that room is still there.

clips.text: But now, its door is always open.

subtitle.zh: 现在，那些碎片仍在原地，只是我不必再回去扮演一个虚假的自己。
subtitle.en: But now, its door is always open.

clips.text: No one is afraid of flying insects here, I hope.

subtitle.zh: 但愿没人害怕飞虫。
subtitle.en: No one is afraid of flying insects here, I hope.

clips.text: An effective way of gathering intelligence, indeed.

subtitle.zh: 我同意，这也是获取情报的有效方式。
subtitle.en: An effective way of gathering intelligence, indeed.

clips.text: Wait for the right moment.

subtitle.zh: 静候时机，小心不起眼的飞虫，闭上眼吧，痛苦不会持续太久。
subtitle.en: Wait for the right moment.

clips.text: Even the most unremarkable insect may have a deadly sting.

subtitle.zh: 静候时机，小心不起眼的飞虫，闭上眼吧，痛苦不会持续太久。
subtitle.en: Even the most unremarkable insect may have a deadly sting.

clips.text: Close your eyes.

subtitle.zh: 静候时机，小心不起眼的飞虫，闭上眼吧，痛苦不会持续太久。
subtitle.en: Close your eyes.

clips.text: The pain will pass quickly.

subtitle.zh: 静候时机，小心不起眼的飞虫，闭上眼吧，痛苦不会持续太久。
subtitle.en: The pain will pass quickly.

clips.text: That blinding light.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: That blinding light.

clips.text: Come loose like a breaking cocoon.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: Come loose like a breaking cocoon.

clips.text: Death is on its wings.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: Death is on its wings.

clips.text: Like a moth to the flame, at the quiver of scaled wings, lift the veil of lies.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: Like a moth to the flame, at the quiver of scaled wings, lift the veil of lies.

clips.text: Please don't worry.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: Please don't worry.

clips.text: I can tidy up, or make this look like nothing more than a tragic accident.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: I can tidy up, or make this look like nothing more than a tragic accident.

clips.text: Just tell me what you need.

subtitle.zh: 那灼目的光，抽丝剥茧，翩然的死亡，飞蛾扑火，听鳞翅的震颤。在那无数谎言的帷幕之后，不必在意，我可以为你掩盖战斗留下的痕迹，或者让现场看起来像是一次意外事故，有需要的话，尽情吩咐。
subtitle.en: Just tell me what you need.

clips.text: At last, the moth, long abandoned in a dark corner, comes to feel the sun's warmth.

subtitle.zh: 终于，那只长久被遗弃在黑暗角落里的飞蛾，也感受到了阳光的温暖。
subtitle.en: At last, the moth, long abandoned in a dark corner, comes to feel the sun's warmth.

clips.text: The rightful owners of those names are gone.

subtitle.zh: 那些名字真正的主人已经逝去，而窃取了它们的小偷却获得了第二次生命。
subtitle.en: The rightful owners of those names are gone.

clips.text: Yet their thief was granted a second life.

subtitle.zh: 那些名字真正的主人已经逝去，而窃取了它们的小偷却获得了第二次生命。
subtitle.en: Yet their thief was granted a second life.

clips.text: I hope, in time, I can find some way to honor them.

subtitle.zh: 但愿我能带着那些破碎的名字，找回属于我自己的生命。
subtitle.en: I hope, in time, I can find some way to honor them.
